newsitem.title: GERMANY: Joyrider jailed for killing Briton in Germany.
newsitem.headline: Joyrider jailed for killing Briton in Germany.

text.p: A German teenager was jailed for three years and nine months on Monday for killing a British construction worker in 1994 by running him over in a stolen car and dragging his body nearly 10 km (six miles).

The court in the east German city of Schwerin found Steffen Hartmann, now 19, guilty of negligent driving. It ruled that he should have noticed Briton Lee Hawthorn, who was drunk and lying in the road at the time.
The court heard that the 32-year-old from Milton Keynes, Buckinghamshire, probably died while being dragged, caught by the underside of the car.
Had Hartmann stopped at once, the court heard, Hawthorn would have survived because the car wheels did not initially run him over.
Hartmann, who was 16 at the time and driving without a licence, denied the charges and remained silent thoughout the trial. He had previously withdrawn a confession.
